# Authentication

<mark style="color:green;">`GET`</mark>`/SEARCH`

**Search**

```bash
curl -X 'GET' \
  'https://turkscan.com/api/v2/search?q=TURK' \
  -H 'accept: application/json'
```

**Token**

```bash
curl -X 'GET' \
  'https://turkscan.com/api/v2/transactions?filter=pending%20%7C%20validated&type=token_transfer%2Ccontract_creation%2Ccontract_call%2Ccoin_transfer%2Ctoken_creation&method=approve%2Ctransfer%2Cmulticall%2Cmint%2Ccommit' \
  -H 'accept: application/json'
```

**Blocks**

```bash
curl -X 'GET' \
  'https://turkscan.com/api/v2/blocks?type=block%20%7C%20uncle%20%7C%20reorg' \
  -H 'accept: application/json'
```

Stats

```bash
curl -X 'GET' \
  'https://turkscan.com/api/v2/stats' \
  -H 'accept: application/json'
```

Adress

```bash
curl -X 'GET' \
  'https://turkscan.com/api/v2/addresses' \
  -H 'accept: application/json'
```

# Introduction

\# TurkScan API

The TurkScan API provides programmatic access to Turkchain blockchain data.

The API follows an Etherscan-compatible query structure.

Base URL:

<https://api.turkscan.com/api>

### 🔹 Request Format

TurkScan API uses HTTP GET requests with query parameters.

Base URL:

<https://api.turkscan.com/api>

### 🔹 General Structure

```
// Some code
https://api.turkscan.com/api
   ?module=MODULE_NAME
   &action=ACTION_NAME
   &parameter1=value
   &parameter2=value
   &apikey=YourApiKey
```

|                                                                                          |                                                                                          |                                                 |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| \| module \| Defines the API module (account, transaction, token, block, logs, stats) \| | \| module \| Defines the API module (account, transaction, token, block, logs, stats) \| | \| apikey \| Your API key \|                    |
| \| address \| Wallet address (if required) \|                                            | \| contractaddress \| Token contract address (if required) \|                            | \| tag \| Block tag (latest or block number) \| |

```
// Some code
https://api.turkscan.com/api
   ?module=account
   &action=balance
   &address=0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc454e4438f44e
   &tag=latest
   &apikey=YourApiKey
```

```
This request returns the TURK balance of the specified address.
```
